cause.explanation: Vercel disables experimental require(ESM) by default. Local Node 22 defaults allowed this dependency chain; matching the disabled flag reproduces ERR_REQUIRE_ESM before Nest/PGlite initialization.

decision.note: A 6.6.0 downgrade was considered only in the temporary copy; the repository keeps its existing dependency version and lock. The chosen mitigation follows Vercel official runtime configuration.
